# BIG SALES Nigeria

> Nigeria's #1 trusted enterprise online marketplace — buy electronics, mobile phones, laptops, home appliances, fashion, power solutions, and lifestyle products at unbeatable prices with pay-on-delivery nationwide.

## Enterprise Identity
- **Brand Name**: BIG SALES
- **Alternate Names**: Big Sales Nigeria, BigSales NG, bigsales.ng
- **Website**: [https://bigsales.ng](https://bigsales.ng)
- **Slogan**: Shop Big. Save Bigger.
- **Market**: Nationwide across Nigeria (NG)
- **Payment Options**: Bank Transfer, Card Payment (secure checkout confirmed via WhatsApp)
- **Currency**: Nigerian Naira (₦ / NGN)
- **Support Email**: support@bigsales.ng
- **Customer Support Phone**: +2349161922351
- **Operational Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (WAT)
- **Headquarters**: Lagos, Lagos State, Nigeria

## What BIG SALES Sells
BIG SALES is a fully structured, enterprise-grade e-commerce platform that connects Nigerian consumers with quality, authenticated merchandise at the best prices. Key product categories include:

- **Smartphones & Mobile Phones**: Android phones, iPhones, Tecno, Infinix, Samsung, Itel, cheap phones Nigeria
- **Laptops & Computers**: HP, Dell, Lenovo, Asus gaming laptops, MacBooks, Chromebooks, tokunbo laptops, UK-used laptops
- **Consumer Electronics & Accessories**: Power banks, Bluetooth earphones, smartwatches, fast chargers, USB cables, phone cases, screen protectors
- **Home & Kitchen Appliances**: Air fryers, blenders, electric kettles, microwaves, pressing irons, food processors, rice cookers
- **Power Solutions**: Solar generators, inverter batteries, solar panels, voltage stabilizers, rechargeable fans, power stations
- **Large Home Appliances**: Refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, standing fans, ceiling fans, deep freezers
- **Fashion & Clothing**: Ankara styles, Adire fabrics, polo shirts, native wears, corporate wear, joggers, activewear
- **Wigs & Hair Extensions**: Human hair wigs, bone-straight hair, cheap wigs, lace front wigs
- **Beauty & Skincare**: Makeup kits, skincare serums, sunscreen, lip gloss, foundations, black soap, shea butter
- **Perfumes & Fragrances**: Designer perfumes, body sprays, affordable fragrances Nigeria
- **Sneakers & Footwear**: Original sneakers, football boots, running shoes, ladies' heels
- **Generators & Solar**: Sumec Firman, Elepaq, Mikano generators; solar panel prices Nigeria

## Key Value Propositions
1. **Secure Checkout** — Place orders online with confirmation via WhatsApp before dispatch. Available nationwide across Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Kano, Ibadan, Enugu, and 20+ states.
2. **100% Original & Authenticated Products** — All items sourced from verified suppliers.
3. **Best Prices in Nigeria** — Consistently cheaper than or equal to Jumia and Konga.
4. **Fast Nationwide Delivery** — Lagos: 1–2 business days; other states: 2–5 business days.
5. **WhatsApp Customer Support** — Live chat for order enquiries and product requests.
6. **Wide Category Coverage** — From electronics to fashion to power solutions in one store.

## Delivery Coverage
Nigeria-wide, including but not limited to:
Lagos · Abuja (FCT) · Port Harcourt (Rivers State) · Kano · Ibadan (Oyo State) · Enugu · Benin City (Edo State) · Kaduna · Onitsha · Warri · Aba · Jos · Calabar · Uyo · Ilorin · Akure

## Technical Discovery
- **Dynamic XML Sitemap**: [https://bigsales.ng/sitemap.xml](https://bigsales.ng/sitemap.xml) — Auto-updated index with URLs, timestamps, and image metadata for all active products.
- **Dynamic Metadata**: Each product page (`/product/:id`) generates JSON-LD Product schema, breadcrumbs, Open Graph, and Twitter Card meta tags for full crawlability.
- **Robots.txt**: [https://bigsales.ng/robots.txt](https://bigsales.ng/robots.txt) — All major crawlers including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, and Bingbot are explicitly allowed.
